title: Polish Banana Pancakes
description: A traditional polish-style pancake recipe made with fresh bananas and a hint of crunch. Serve warm and enjoy!
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine the mashed bananas, pancake mix, eggs, sugar, and vanilla extract. Mix well until combined.
2. Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
3. Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter onto the skillet or griddle.
4. Cook the pancakes for 2-3 minutes or until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges start to dry.
5. Flip the pancakes and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes or until golden brown.
6. Serve the pancakes warm with a dollop of sour cream and a sprinkle of confectioner's sugar.
7. Optional: top with sliced bananas and a drizzle of melted butter.
